source_target_name: RMA or USDA recovery and receivables materials
source_target_scope: Find whether FCIC improper-payment dollars are recorded as receivables, collections, recoveries, debts, or otherwise collectible amounts.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only reports improper-payment estimates or root-cause categories without collectible-dollar treatment, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

source_target_scope: Find whether specific FCIC controls, data mining, compliance reviews, or corrective actions tie preventable dollars to the improper-payment estimate.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only describes process improvements without tying dollars to preventable or recoverable amounts, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
source_target_name: VA or VHA bills-of-collection and overpayment materials
source_target_scope: Find whether PLTSS incorrect-amount findings are converted into bills of collection, recoveries, debts, or collectible overpayment amounts.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only reports aggregate overpayments or improper and unknown payments without a recoverable incorrect-amount subset, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
